name: openclaw-loop-runner
description: Looping long-task supervisor for OpenClaw-style task bundles with output contracts, gates, and rerun plans.

interface.shortDescription: Run long OpenClaw tasks with looped verification.
interface.longDescription: Openclaw Loop Runner helps Codex split long tasks into contract-bound task bundles, require file outputs, verify coverage, generate rerun plans, and keep looping until gates pass.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use OpenClaw Loop Runner to plan, dispatch, verify, and rerun a long task until all output contracts pass.
